recentItems.description:

Karnataka’s 33-member Cabinet currently has no women ministers, while Himachal Pradesh has also faced scrutiny. Congress’ Karnataka district president appointments have further sparked debate, putting the party’s claims on women’s empowerment and political representation under the spotlight.
